name: Fiji lymphatic filariasis transmission report
notes:
Fiji lymphatic filariasis transmission report v2.24
This report generates a list of patients that have had a 'Post - MDA Transmission Survey - Part A - Registration' form completed. Each line in the report represents the completion of a single registration form. The report combines details from both the 'Post-MDA Transmission Survey - Part A - Registration' and 'Post-MDA Transmission Survey - Part B - Result' forms. Patients are listed in chronological order by date of 'Post - MDA Transmission Survey - Part A - Registration' form submission.
